title: Find Middle of Linked List
problem: Given the head of a singly linked list, return the middle node of the linked list. If there are two middle nodes, return the second middle node.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 100].
hints: Fast pointer moves twice as fast as slow pointer.
code:
def solution(head):
    slow = head
    fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
    return slow
